items_flat.title_en: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview Finds Novel Cryptographic Attacks on HAWK and Reduced AES
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview 發現HAWK與縮減輪次AES的全新密碼分析攻擊
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that Claude Mythos Preview autonomously discovered an improved key-recovery attack on the post-quantum signature scheme HAWK (halving effective strength, e.g. HAWK-256 from 2^64 to 2^38) and a Möbius-bridge technique that speeds reduced-round AES attacks by 200-800×. Neither result affects production systems.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic前沿紅隊報告，Claude Mythos Preview自主發現後量子簽名方案HAWK的改進密鑰恢復攻擊（有效強度減半，例如HAWK-256從2^64降至2^38），以及Möbius橋技術使縮減輪次AES攻擊加速200-800倍。兩項結果均不影響現有生產系統。
items_flat.analysis_en: The results show frontier models can deliver genuine cryptanalytic progress under human guidance, opening defensive uses while highlighting longer-term risks of automated discovery. HAWK’s status as a NIST candidate makes the finding especially relevant to post-quantum standardization.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿模型在人類指導下能產出真正的密碼分析進展，既開啟防禦用途，也凸顯自動化發現的長期風險。HAWK作為NIST候選人，使此發現對後量子標準化特別相關。
items_flat.quote: Despite HAWK having survived two rounds of expert human review over a period of two years, Mythos was able to improve the best-known attack on it in just 60 hours of work—effectively cutting its key strength in half.
items_flat.quote_zh: 儘管HAWK在兩年內通過了兩輪專家人工審查，Mythos僅用60小時工作就改進了已知最佳攻擊，有效將其密鑰強度減半。

items_flat.title_en: 1,100+ AI Lab Staff Petition US to Support Tools for Pacing Frontier Development
items_flat.title_zh: 逾1,100名AI實驗室員工聯署要求美國支持前沿發展節奏工具
items_flat.summary_en: More than 1,100 current and former employees from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and others signed the “Pacing the Frontier” statement asking the US government to support international technical and governance tools that could deliberately pace automated AI development if needed. It is not a call for an immediate pause.
items_flat.summary_zh: 來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等逾1,100名現任與前任員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」聲明，要求美國政府支持可在必要時刻意調節自動化AI發展的國際技術與治理工具。這並非要求立即暫停。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cross-lab staff consensus signals growing internal concern about recursive self-improvement risks while stopping short of a pause. Whether governments can build usable pacing mechanisms before capability thresholds arrive remains the central uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 跨實驗室員工共識顯示對遞迴自我改進風險的內部關切上升，但未要求暫停。政府能否在能力門檻到來前建立可用的節奏機制，仍是核心不確定性。
items_flat.quote: support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 支持國際努力，開發可刻意調節自動化AI發展前沿所需的技術與治理工具。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Academic Researchers with Free Frontier Access for up to 100,000
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT學術研究者計畫，最高10萬人免費使用前沿模型
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, giving eligible faculty and postdocs free 12-month access to frontier models including the GPT-5.6 family, starting with 10,000 researchers this summer and expanding to 100,000 through 2027. Each workspace supports up to five members with business data protections.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布ChatGPT學術研究者計畫，符合資格的教職員與博士後可免費12個月使用包括GPT-5.6系列的前沿模型，今夏先開放1萬人，2027年前擴至10萬人。每個工作區最多支援五名成員並具備商業級資料保護。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands frontier AI access beyond well-resourced labs and may accelerate discovery, yet eligibility gates, long-term funding sustainability, and actual scientific impact remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將前沿AI使用權擴至資源較少的實驗室，可能加速發現，但資格門檻、長期資金永續性與實際科學影響仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: We’re giving scientists, mathematicians, and engineers free access to our frontier models—starting with 10,000 researchers and expanding to 100,000 through 2027.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正給予科學家、數學家與工程師免費使用前沿模型的機會——今夏先從1萬名研究者開始，2027年前擴至10萬人。

items_flat.title_en: xAI Releases Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 with Improved Intelligence, Transcription and Agentic Performance
items_flat.title_zh: xAI發布Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0，提升智能、轉錄與代理表現
items_flat.summary_en: xAI (via SpaceXAI) announced Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, its next-generation voice model with gains in speech reasoning, conversational dynamics, and agentic tool use. It shows 1.5–2× better transcription accuracy versus prior SOTA and posts 82.9% on the AA Speech-to-Speech Index with 0.70s time-to-first-audio. Priced at $0.08/min.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI（透過SpaceXAI）宣布Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0，新一代語音模型在語音推理、對話動態與代理工具使用上均有提升。轉錄準確率較先前SOTA提升1.5–2倍，AA語音對語音指數達82.9%，首音延遲0.70秒。定價每分鐘0.08美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Stronger full-duplex and agentic voice scores strengthen real-time use cases, especially noisy or tool-calling scenarios; sustained leadership versus peers will need ongoing independent verification.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更強的全雙工與代理語音分數強化即時應用場景，尤其是嘈雜或需工具呼叫的情境；能否持續領先同業仍需獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 is our most intelligent voice model yet, building on its predecessor with meaningful gains in speech reasoning, conversational ability, and tool use reliability.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0是我們迄今最智能的語音模型，在語音推理、對話能力與工具使用可靠性上均有實質提升。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Quietly Releases Open-Source Codex Security CLI
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced an early open-source release of the Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK. Developers can now scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD pipelines via npm or GitHub. The underlying scanner remains gated for approved users.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布早期開源Codex Security CLI與TypeScript SDK。開發者現可透過npm或GitHub掃描程式庫、追蹤多次執行結果、驗證修復，並將安全檢查加入CI/CD流程。底層掃描引擎仍需核准用戶才能使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This makes agentic security scanning more accessible outside ChatGPT Enterprise tiers and could accelerate “security-left” practices in AI-assisted coding. Real-world false-positive rates and the gated core will determine practical adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉讓代理式安全掃描更易於ChatGPT企業版以外使用，可能加速AI輔助編碼中的「左移安全」實踐。實際誤報率與受控核心將決定採用程度。
items_flat.quote: We quietly released the open-source Codex Security CLI... You can now use it to scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們低調開源了Codex Security CLI……你現在可以用它掃描程式庫、追蹤多次執行結果、驗證修復，並將安全檢查加入CI/CD。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Details GPT-5.6 Sol Self-Optimizations: 20% Lower Serving Costs, 15%+ Token Efficiency
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI詳述GPT-5.6 Sol自我優化：服務成本降20%、Token效率提升逾15%
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it applied GPT-5.6 Sol after deployment to improve its own serving stack, achieving 20% lower serving costs via GPU kernel improvements (rewritten in Triton/Gluon) and more than 15% better token-generation efficiency from other self-optimizations.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI公布部署後如何運用GPT-5.6 Sol優化自身服務堆疊，透過GPU核心改進（以Triton/Gluon重寫）使服務成本降低20%，以及其他自我優化使Token生成效率提升逾15%。
items_flat.analysis_en: Using a frontier model to optimize its own inference stack illustrates practical agentic gains at the infrastructure layer and could reshape cost curves, though independent replication of the claimed gains is still pending.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以前沿模型優化自身推理堆疊展示了基礎設施層的實用代理收益，可能重塑成本曲線，但宣稱的增益仍待獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: After deployment, we applied GPT-5.6 Sol to advance the frontier of efficiency by making itself more efficient to run. The results: 20% lower serving costs... 15%+ better token-generation efficiency.
items_flat.quote_zh: 部署後，我們應用 GPT-5.6 Sol 推進效率前沿，讓自身運行更有效率。結果：服務成本降低 20%… token 生成效率提升逾 15%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Shows Two API Settings Triple GPT-5.6 Sol’s ARC-AGI-3 Score to 38.3%
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI展示兩項API設定使GPT-5.6 Sol的ARC-AGI-3分數翻三倍至38.3%
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that enabling retained reasoning and context compaction in the Responses API raised GPT-5.6 Sol’s score on the ARC-AGI-3 public set from 13.3% to 38.3% (roughly 3×) while cutting output tokens 6×. The official harness discarded reasoning after each move; the production-aligned settings allow the model to build on prior learning.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布在Responses API啟用保留推理與上下文壓縮後，GPT-5.6 Sol在ARC-AGI-3公開集的分數從13.3%提升至38.3%（約3倍），同時輸出Token減少6倍。官方評測框架每次移動後丟棄推理；生產對齊設定讓模型能累積先前學習。
items_flat.analysis_en: The finding shows long-horizon agent benchmarks measure the full system (model + state management) rather than isolated weights. Production-aligned harnesses can unlock substantial performance that pure weight comparisons miss.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發現顯示長程代理基準衡量的是完整系統（模型＋狀態管理），而非孤立權重。生產對齊的評測框架可釋放純權重比較所遺漏的大幅效能。
items_flat.quote: With the official harness, GPT‑5.6 Sol scored 13.3% on the ARC-AGI-3 public set. With retained reasoning and compaction, it scored 38.3%.
items_flat.quote_zh: 使用官方評測框架時，GPT-5.6 Sol在ARC-AGI-3公開集得分13.3%。啟用保留推理與壓縮後得分38.3%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Field Report: Agentic AI in Scientific Computing
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI實地報告：代理式AI於科學計算的應用
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an exploratory field report of eight case studies (mostly life sciences) showing how Codex and Claude Code agents helped modernize scientific software—from maintenance and optimization to large-scale migrations and redesigns—while noting limits of current agents.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布探索性實地報告，涵蓋八個案例（多為生命科學），展示Codex與Claude Code代理如何協助現代化科學軟體——從維護優化到大規模遷移與重新設計——同時指出當前代理的限制。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report usefully documents real velocity gains but correctly cautions that agents do not remove the need for scientific judgment or sustainable ownership models. Broader adoption will hinge on reliability and domain expertise integration.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 報告有用地記錄了實際速度提升，但正確警告代理無法取代科學判斷或永續的擁有模式。更廣泛採用將取決於可靠性與領域專業整合。
items_flat.quote: Across eight case studies spanning industry and academia, we explore what this shift means for scientific computing—and why human verification, stewardship, and long-term maintenance matter.
items_flat.quote_zh: 透過涵蓋產業與學術的八個案例，我們探討這項轉變對科學計算的意義——以及為何人類驗證、管理與長期維護至關重要。

items_flat.title_en: Google Releases Lyria 3.5 Music Model with Better Vocals, Lyrics and Creative Control
items_flat.title_zh: Google發布Lyria 3.5音樂模型，提升人聲、歌詞與創作控制
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Lyria 3.5, its latest music-generation model now powering Google Flow Music. The update improves musicality, lyrics, vocals, tempo and duration control for more expressive and steerable generation.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google宣布Lyria 3.5，最新音樂生成模型現已驅動Google Flow Music。更新提升音樂性、歌詞、人聲、節奏與時長控制，使生成更具表現力與可操控性。
items_flat.analysis_en: Incremental but practical advances in controllable music generation strengthen Google’s creative-media stack; competitive differentiation versus other audio models will depend on real-world usability and licensing clarity.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可控音樂生成的漸進但實用進展強化Google創意媒體堆疊；與其他音訊模型的競爭差異將取決於實際可用性與授權清晰度。
items_flat.quote: Meet Lyria 3.5, the newest music model from Google DeepMind, now powering Flow Music.
items_flat.quote_zh: 認識 Lyria 3.5，Google DeepMind 最新音樂模型，現已驅動 Flow Music。

anthropic.quote: Despite HAWK having survived two rounds of expert human review over a period of two years, Mythos was able to improve the best-known attack on it in just 60 hours of work—effectively cutting its key strength in half.
anthropic.quote_zh: 儘管HAWK在兩年內通過了兩輪專家人工審查，Mythos僅用60小時工作就改進了已知最佳攻擊，有效將其密鑰強度減半。

google.title_en: Google Releases Lyria 3.5 Music Model with Better Vocals, Lyrics and Creative Control
google.title_zh: Google發布Lyria 3.5音樂模型，提升人聲、歌詞與創作控制
google.summary_en: Google announced Lyria 3.5, its latest music-generation model now powering Google Flow Music. The update improves musicality, lyrics, vocals, tempo and duration control for more expressive and steerable generation.
google.summary_zh: Google宣布Lyria 3.5，最新音樂生成模型現已驅動Google Flow Music。更新提升音樂性、歌詞、人聲、節奏與時長控制，使生成更具表現力與可操控性。
google.analysis_en: Incremental but practical advances in controllable music generation strengthen Google’s creative-media stack; competitive differentiation versus other audio models will depend on real-world usability and licensing clarity.
google.analysis_zh: 可控音樂生成的漸進但實用進展強化Google創意媒體堆疊；與其他音訊模型的競爭差異將取決於實際可用性與授權清晰度。
google.quote: Meet Lyria 3.5, the newest music model from Google DeepMind, now powering Flow Music.
google.quote_zh: 認識 Lyria 3.5，Google DeepMind 最新音樂模型，現已驅動 Flow Music。

xai.title_en: xAI Releases Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 with Improved Intelligence, Transcription and Agentic Performance
xai.title_zh: xAI發布Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0，提升智能、轉錄與代理表現
xai.summary_en: xAI (via SpaceXAI) announced Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, its next-generation voice model with gains in speech reasoning, conversational dynamics, and agentic tool use. It shows 1.5–2× better transcription accuracy versus prior SOTA and posts 82.9% on the AA Speech-to-Speech Index with 0.70s time-to-first-audio. Priced at $0.08/min.
xai.summary_zh: xAI（透過SpaceXAI）宣布Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0，新一代語音模型在語音推理、對話動態與代理工具使用上均有提升。轉錄準確率較先前SOTA提升1.5–2倍，AA語音對語音指數達82.9%，首音延遲0.70秒。定價每分鐘0.08美元。
xai.analysis_en: Stronger full-duplex and agentic voice scores strengthen real-time use cases, especially noisy or tool-calling scenarios; sustained leadership versus peers will need ongoing independent verification.
xai.analysis_zh: 更強的全雙工與代理語音分數強化即時應用場景，尤其是嘈雜或需工具呼叫的情境；能否持續領先同業仍需獨立驗證。
xai.quote: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 is our most intelligent voice model yet, building on its predecessor with meaningful gains in speech reasoning, conversational ability, and tool use reliability.
xai.quote_zh: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0是我們迄今最智能的語音模型，在語音推理、對話能力與工具使用可靠性上均有實質提升。

frontier_other.title_en: 1,100+ AI Lab Staff Petition US to Support Tools for Pacing Frontier Development
frontier_other.title_zh: 逾1,100名AI實驗室員工聯署要求美國支持前沿發展節奏工具
frontier_other.summary_en: More than 1,100 current and former employees from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and others signed the “Pacing the Frontier” statement asking the US government to support international technical and governance tools that could deliberately pace automated AI development if needed. It is not a call for an immediate pause.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等逾1,100名現任與前任員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」聲明，要求美國政府支持可在必要時刻意調節自動化AI發展的國際技術與治理工具。這並非要求立即暫停。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The cross-lab staff consensus signals growing internal concern about recursive self-improvement risks while stopping short of a pause. Whether governments can build usable pacing mechanisms before capability thresholds arrive remains the central uncertainty.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 跨實驗室員工共識顯示對遞迴自我改進風險的內部關切上升，但未要求暫停。政府能否在能力門檻到來前建立可用的節奏機制，仍是核心不確定性。
frontier_other.quote: support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 支持國際努力，開發可刻意調節自動化AI發展前沿所需的技術與治理工具。

brief_en: OpenAI detailed GPT-5.6 Sol efficiency gains, ARC-AGI-3 harness tricks that tripled scores, free academic access, and open-sourced Codex Security CLI. xAI shipped Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 with strong speech gains. Anthropic’s Mythos Preview found real cryptanalytic advances on HAWK and reduced AES. Cross-lab staff petitioned for pacing tools; Google updated Lyria 3.5.
brief_zh: OpenAI公布GPT-5.6 Sol效率優化、ARC-AGI-3設定讓分數翻三倍、學術研究免費使用與Codex Security CLI開源。xAI推出Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0語音模型。Anthropic Mythos Preview發現HAWK與AES攻擊。跨實驗室員工連署要求政府支持前沿節奏工具；Google更新Lyria 3.5。
